name: Luisa's Pollo Asado with Cilantro Rice & Sweet Plantains (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Roasted chicken breast/thigh with white rice and soft sweet maduro plantains offers high protein and soluble starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Lighter Note plain roasted chicken breast (to avoid citrus-achiote marinade on the skin) with steamed white rice and sweet plantains.
watchOuts: Citrus-achiote marinade on standard Pollo Asado skin
Whole black beans if plated alongside
